name: AICardBrief
description: The AI Card Brief surfaces the structured task brief for an agent, showing goal, data sources, constraints, and expected output. It is the foundational transparency layer for AI Led experiences — always surfaced before an agent executes a consequential action.
intent: Pre-execution brief for an agent task. Surfaces goal, data sources, constraints, and output format so humans can review and approve before the AI acts.
